g.text: Measuring a beach profile: equipment and transect
(b) Side view along the transect (not to scale)
Start at the fixed reference post R and lay the transect
perpendicular to the shoreline, on an approved safe beach, away
Place poles at each break of slope; measure each segment with the
tape and sight the clinometer between the same marks on both
Record each segment’s distance (m), angle (°) and whether it
rises or falls, so the profile can be plotted on stated scales.
Beach A profile and field-record headings
Field record for each profile segment
